# FLX-3404: --shard is not a share of a run

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

`--shard I/N` asks for the I-th of N shares of every emit's rows, and both are whole numbers with N at least 1 and I from 1 to N: `--shard 2/4` is the second quarter. A share is a contiguous range of row indexes, so the shares joined in order are the bytes of one run. Anything else (a fraction, a zero, an I past N, text) names no share, and is refused before any row is made. Sharding is a feature of kernel 0.2.0, as scaling is: a plan under kernel 0.1.0 refuses it.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3404
```
